title: Active Directory on Ubuntu with Samba
tagline: Step-by-step setup of a Samba/LDAP domain controller on Ubuntu.
description: I wrote a guide to create a Samba domain on Ubuntu with Kerberos and DNS. I cover server preparation and Windows and Linux client integration.
features: Preparing the Ubuntu environment with a static IP, hostname and resolv.conf.
Installing the Samba AD, Kerberos and Winbind dependencies.
Provisioning the domain with samba-tool and enabling the samba-ad-dc service.
Configuring Kerberos and checking the domain DNS records.
Procedure for joining Windows and Linux workstations to the domain.
A documentation base for later management of users and groups.
challenges: I needed to keep Samba, Kerberos and DNS consistent. I paid particular attention to the domain name, DNS records and configuration order.
learnings: I deepened my understanding of Samba domains and learned to document a repeatable system configuration.
